answer: An identity enters only inside a falcon's web: it locks haven with that falcon, and the beacon, not the falcon, draws each epoch which of its sponsorees gets audited; a fake found doubles the haven floor of every member of that web. So an operator running k clones through one web compounds its own bill: its newest clone posts base×2^(k−1) haven while all k−1 elders must top up to match — about base×2^k locked in total. A newcomer enters a clean web and posts base.
